title: Neural Networks for Singular Perturbations -- Finite Regularity
summary: We study finite-element and deep feedforward neural network (DNN for short) expressivity rate bounds for solution sets of a model linear, second order singularly perturbed, elliptic two-point boundary value problem, in Sobolev norms on a bounded interval $(-1,1)$, with explicit dependence on the singular perturbation parameter $\e\in (0,1]$. Emphasis is on low Sobolev regularity of the data, i.e., source term $f$ and reaction coefficient $b$.
